about: Hand-tampered EHF documents and the rule ids each must trip (EHF and KID design D11). Each is a golden under testdata/golden with one change, written once and committed; go test -update never rewrites them. `rules` are the fatal ids the oracle (tools/ehf, the official XSD and Schematron) must report, exactly; `module` are the module's own ids for a check no official rule names. TestPrecheck_AgreesWithTheManifest holds the Go pre-check and invariants to every id here they know. Ids as the oracle reports them over peppol-bis-invoice-3 v3.0.20 and eInvoicing-EN16931 validation-1.3.16 (tools/ehf/artefacts.lock); an artefact bump re-checks them.
